name: ai-install-guard
description: A pre-install security gate for Claude Code: scans plugins, mods, skills and MCP servers without running them, and installs nothing until you approve.

outsideLookups.title: Outside lookups
outsideLookups.description: Check the packages a plugin uses against OSV, and its name against Anthropic's official plugins. Sends package and plugin names to those services. Off by default.
